fields.reasoning: 58% of internal/api's CPU is store.ReadLog because every write re-reads the log, so the cheap fix without projection is to make those writes once; a copied template keeps each test isolated (no test sees another's writes), which parallel tests need, where a shared read-only model would not let tests write.
fields.statement: internal/api's shared fixtures are built once per test binary into a template folder and copied into each test's own temporary folder, so a test still owns and may write its repo while the model-building writes run once

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run '^TestSnapshotFixture' shows a fixture's copy folds to the same model as building it afresh, and a write in one test's copy is not seen by another's; failure case: a fixture whose build fails fails every test that asks for it with the build's error, not a missing folder. Speedup measure: go test -trimpath -count=1 -cpuprofile $TMPDIR/api.prof ./internal/api -skip '^(TestReadBudget|TestReadBudgetApply|TestDriverPollIsCheap)$' then go tool pprof -top -cum $TMPDIR/api.prof shows store.ReadLog under 30% of CPU (2026-11-15: 58%). Touches internal/api's test helpers and the _test.go files moved onto the fixtures. Must not change non-test code, and must not replace FoldLog (projection is out of scope).
fields.statement: internal/api's tests get their common starting repos (the models many tests rebuild through the same writes) from snapshot fixtures: each is built once per test binary into a template and copied per test, instead of each test re-applying the writes and re-reading the log after each.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 -shuffle=on ./internal/api -skip '^(TestReadBudget|TestReadBudgetApply|TestDriverPollIsCheap)$' passes twice in a row with different shuffle seeds; go vet ./internal/api is clean; failure case: go test -trimpath -race -count=1 ./internal/api -run on the tests that swap package variables shows no data race. Speedup measure (orchestrator, quiet VM): /usr/bin/time -f '%e s' go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -skip <the budgets> within 150 s (2026-11-15: 388 s). Touches internal/api/*_test.go only. Must not skip, delete or merge a test: go test -list '.*' ./internal/api counts the same tests as before.
fields.statement: internal/api's independent tests call t.Parallel(); a test that swaps a package variable (runClock and the like), calls t.Setenv or t.Chdir, or reads shared machine state stays serial, and a comment on each such swap says why it must.
